name: Drive G36
positioning: 36 mm gravel wheelset with a 25 mm hooked rim, steel CX-Ray spokes and a 50T star-ratchet hub.

rim.bead_note: Listed as hooked; the maker describes a reduced-hook design.

max_pressure.note: Not published on the product page; the maker refers to its user guide.

load_limit.note: Includes rider, bike, gear and accessories.

weight.basis: Pair without tubeless valves and rim tape, although both ship installed.

hub: Elitewheels Kinetic · two 50T star ratchets (7.2°) · TPI steel bearings

price_observations.conditions: The store advertises free shipping and customs duties for the US, EU, UK and Australia. Thru-axles are not included.

caveats: Freehub bodies are made by Elitewheels; other brands' freehubs do not fit.
No maximum tire pressure is printed on the product page.
Mainland China price not recorded; confirm it with an authorized seller.

image.alt: Elitewheels Drive G36 carbon gravel wheelset pair with gold Drive rim decals on a black background
